cases.name: unknown parameter return
cases.contract: No literal value proof; no new definite scalar rejection.

cases.name: unknown property value
cases.contract: No literal value proof; no new definite scalar rejection.

cases.name: alias mutation before property write
cases.contract: Alias mutation must not retain a stale literal value.

cases.name: unknown call before property write
cases.contract: Do not treat a stale literal as a guaranteed runtime value.

cases.name: branch before property write
cases.contract: Do not choose a single branch as the input value.

cases.name: annotation only declared property
cases.contract: Preserve existing PHPDoc diagnostic policy; no invented native conversion.

cases.name: annotation only magic property
cases.contract: Preserve existing PHPDoc diagnostic policy; no invented native conversion.

cases.name: inherited native property
cases.definitions: class Base{public int $mode;}class Holder extends Base{}
cases.contract: Native owner is Base even when accessed on Holder.

cases.name: trait native property
cases.contract: Recover the native Trait declaration through existing ownership.

cases.name: duplicate holder declaration
cases.contract: Conflicting native declarations must not be treated as a unique contract.

cases.name: promoted native type with annotation
cases.contract: Original native parameter type must survive promotion.

cases.name: expanded set hook type
cases.contract: Write contract is the set parameter, not the read/storage type.

cases.name: untyped default
cases.definitions: class Row{}class Other{}/** @return ($mode is int ? Row : Other) */function make($mode=42){}
cases.contract: Omitted untyped literal still selects the original conditional branch.

cases.name: class-string default
cases.definitions: class Row{}class Other{}/** @return ($mode is class-string ? Row : Other) */function make(string $mode=Row::class){}
cases.contract: Class-string evidence must not be replaced with a guessed numeric conversion.

scope: Explicit native proof guards plus preserved annotation/unknown-value diagnostic policy.
